assessment.rationale: Span 67 states that on September 17, 1787, at Independence Hall in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania, 39 delegates endorsed the Constitution. It does not mention 2,417 spectators.

limitations: Span only mentions delegates, not spectators

excerpts.text: On September 17, 1787, at [Independence Hall](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Independence_Hall "Independence Hall") in [Philadelphia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Philadelphia "Philadelphia"), [Pennsylvania](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pennsylvania "Pennsylvania"), 39 delegates to the [Constitutional Convention](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Constitutional_Convention_(United_States) "Constitutional Convention (United States)") endorsed the [Constitution](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/United_States_Constitution "United States Constitution") created during the four-month-long convention.
